svg.title: Topic coverage across the 32 lectures
svg.desc: Heatmap of 144 case studies: one row per canonical topic, one column per lecture. Cell colour deepens with the number of cases; the letter in a cell is the dominant difficulty tier (B beginner, F foundational, I intermediate, A advanced, E expert). Full numbers are in the companion CSV.
